Gaps remaining without a credible alternative

These COMPARE gaps have no best alternative implemented (and often none that belong in DLSurfer).
Everything else from COMPARE_FS_FASTSURFER.md now has a wired best alternative (profile, flag, or engine).

Run: dlsurfer gaps-remaining

Gap

Why no alternative in DLSurfer

What to do instead

Dedicated DLSurfer meta-container (SIF/Docker)

Packaging/ops only — not a morphometry method. No separate science tool substitutes for “our” image.

Use pinned FastSurfer image + host FS; scaffold containers/dlsurfer.def

Manual edit loops (-autorecon2-*)

Interactive QC by design; automation would fight FreeSurfer’s edit model

FreeView + targeted recon-all -autorecon2-* outside DLSurfer

Full QC GUI (FreeView workflows)

GUI is FreeSurfer’s product; DLSurfer is CLI orchestration

Open SUBJECTS_DIR in FreeView

TRACULA / PET / fMRI helper streams

Explicitly out of scope (diffusion/PET/fMRI ≠ T1 morphometry orchestrator)

Use FreeSurfer / modality-specific pipelines

Bit-identical recon-all reproducibility claim

Non-claim: FastSurfer/DLSurfer do not promise bit-identity with classical recon-all

Prefer FS8 profile if you need classical FS tree semantics

True Infant FreeSurfer neonate stream

Only partially covered: fs-clinical = clinical/odd-contrast, not Infant FS

Install Infant FreeSurfer separately (documented runner-up under recon_all_clinical)

Native LIT + optimal GPU/CPU seg↔surf split

Upstream FastSurfer constraint (--lesion_mask blocks --seg_only/--surf_only) — not solvable by another engine

Prefer profile core-lesion (standalone neuroLIT)

Explicitly not “missing alternatives”
